description.text: Students who choose Chinese-teaching courses should study language program for 1-2 years to reach the level equivalent to HSK3, then they can start the clinical courses. Note: a. We’ll start the visa application procedure for the students, after getting their application fees. b. Students should pay all the fees for their first year’s study within one week after their arrival. c. Students have to pay separately for the Internet connection in their room: 30RMB/month. d. Students have to pay separately for the electricity and water used in their room: depends on usage.

duration.text: The Zoology at Jinzhou Medical University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 6.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. Applicant is under the age of 25 2, Be in good health 3. high-school graduate with good marks 4. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
